_meta.purpose: OPTIONAL branching-encounter overlay for the v26 narration overhaul. Each `inject` attaches a `choice` (early beat) or `branches` (later SAME-track beat) onto a named act `phase` of an existing STORY_SCENES entry, without editing generated prose. `choice.persistKey` ties the pair together; the later beat's `branches[].when` matches `{key,eq}` against the stored pick (else the when-less default). Mirrored by DEFAULT_STORY_BRANCH_INJECTS in battle.html (empty by default). IMPORTANT: villain/extra arcs already ship exactly ONE authored choice each (locked by tests/integration/story-narration-system.test.js) — only add a choice to an arc/scene that does NOT already have one, or you'll break that contract. Shape example: { "sceneKey":"...", "phase":"outro", "label":"...", "choice":{ "persistKey":"...", "options":[{ "label":"...", "value":"...", "reply":["..."] }] } } paired with { "sceneKey":"...", "phase":"intro", "branches":[{ "when":{ "key":"...", "eq":"..." }, "lines":["..."] }, { "lines":["default"] }] }.
